import json,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from dongxi_llms.reasoning_evaluation import replay_records,paired_group_bootstrap
R=Path.cwd(); bindings={}; reports=[]; issues=[]
def ident(path):
 p=Path(path);data=p.read_bytes();return {'path':str(p),'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
def check_ref(ref):
 actual=ident(ref['path']);bindings[actual['path']]=actual
 assert actual['sha256']==ref['sha256'] and actual['bytes']==ref['bytes'],ref['path']
def metrics(rows):
 return dict(records=len(rows),correct=sum(r['correct'] for r in rows),natural_stops=sum(r['natural_termination'] for r in rows),truncated=sum(r['truncated'] for r in rows),statuses=dict(Counter(r['status'] for r in rows)),costs={k:sum(r['cost'][k] for r in rows) for k in ('generation_tokens','attempted_forward_tokens','model_forward_tokens','attempted_forward_calls','forward_calls','wall_seconds')})
def held(rows):return [r for r in rows if r['panel_annotation']['campaign_role']=='heldout-controlled-slice' and not r['panel_annotation']['rlvr_train_problem_overlap']]
for budget in (32,128):
 path=R/'experiments/reports'/f'native-rlvr-common20-cap{budget}-20261005-run-02.json';d=json.loads(path.read_text());bindings[str(path)]=ident(path)

 items=d['logical_panel']['items'];index={i['id']:i for i in items};policies={};bs=[]

 for label,bound in d['bindings'].items():

  assert acc['status']=='passed' and all(acc['checks'].values())
  if label!='unchanged-instruct':
   check_ref(bound['supervision_receipt']);sup=json.loads(Path(bound['supervision_receipt']['path']).read_text());assert sup==acc['supervision'] and sup['status']=='completed' and sup['actual_exit_code']==0 and sup['final_record_retained'] is True
   assert bound['sources']==prep['source_bindings'] and bound['inputs']==prep['input_bindings'] and bound['model']==prep['local_model_binding']
  rows=[]
  for cell in prep['cells']:
   contract_path=Path(cell['contract_path']);bindings[str(contract_path)]=ident(contract_path);contract=json.loads(contract_path.read_text())
   raw_path=Path(cell['output'])/'responses.jsonl';raw=[json.loads(x) for x in raw_path.read_text().splitlines() if x.strip()]
   ref=bound['outputs'][cell['id']+'/responses.jsonl'];check_ref(ref);assert ref['path']==str(raw_path)
   assert len(raw)==20 and {r['item_id'] for r in raw}==set(index)
   graded=replay_records(items,raw,contract)['rows']
   for r in graded:
    r['panel_annotation']={k:index[r['item_id']][k] for k in ('family','template_id','problem','rlvr_train_problem_overlap','campaign_role')};r['cell_id']=cell['id']
   rows+=graded
  assert rows==acc['evaluation']['rows'],label
  assert metrics(rows)==d['all_original'][label] and metrics(held(rows))==d['heldout'][label],label
  policies[label]=rows
 for cell in d['cells']:
  aligned={label:[r for r in rows if r['cell_id']==cell['id']] for label,rows in policies.items()};h={label:held(rows) for label,rows in aligned.items()}
  assert cell['all_original']=={k:metrics(v) for k,v in aligned.items()};assert cell['heldout']=={k:metrics(v) for k,v in h.items()}
  assert len({r['contract_id'] for rows in aligned.values() for r in rows})==1
  for label in ('rlvr-g4','rlvr-g8'):
   actual=paired_group_bootstrap(h['unchanged-instruct'],h[label],draws=2000,seed=1010,metric='correct');assert actual==cell['paired_heldout'][label]
   bs.append(dict(cell=cell['id'],policy=label,**{k:v for k,v in actual.items() if k!='samples'},samples_sha256=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(actual['samples'],separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()))
 summary={}
 for label,rows in policies.items():
  h=held(rows);sample=[r for r in h if r['cell_id'].startswith('sample-')];greedy=[r for r in h if r['cell_id'].startswith('greedy-')]
  diagnostic=[r for r in rows if r not in h]
  summary[label]=dict(all_original=metrics(rows),heldout_sample=metrics(sample),heldout_greedy=metrics(greedy),diagnostic=metrics(diagnostic),heldout_correct_capped=sum(r['correct'] and r['truncated'] for r in h),sample_any_candidate_available=sum(any(r['correct'] for r in sample if r['item_id']==i) for i in sorted({r['item_id'] for r in sample})))
 reports.append(dict(budget=budget,comparison=ident(path),source_rows_replayed=sum(len(r) for r in policies.values()),metric_tables_exact=True,bootstrap_panels=bs,policy_summary=summary,bindings_equal=True))
print(json.dumps(dict(schema='dongxi-native-rlvr-common-independent-v1',status='clear',reports=reports,metadata_bindings=bindings,source_rows_replayed=600,new_rows=400,reused_baseline_rows=200,bootstrap_panels_exact=20,bootstrap_draws_each=2000,seed=1010,scope='Model-free saved response/contract/metric/cluster bootstrap replay; no weights, tokenizer, training, generation or new test panel'),allow_nan=False))
